contents.text: Compressed-Gas Reservoir
Stores compressed gas for the vehicle's pneumatic air-jack system.
Pressure Regulator
Regulates gas pressure supplied to the air-jack system.
Air-Jack Lance Receiver
Connection point for the external air lance used during pit servicing.
Reservoir Mounting Straps
Holds the pneumatic reservoir securely in position.
Hood Air Extractor
The hood air extractor helps release hot air from the front cooling system while improving aerodynamic efficiency.
Carbon Fiber Roof
Lightweight carbon-fiber construction helps reduce overall vehicle weight while maintaining the rigidity required for high-performance racing.
Instrument Cluster
Clear and customizable display for essential driving information. Real-time data to keep you informed and in control on every drive.
Steering Wheel
Ergonomic design for a comfortable and secure grip. Precision control for a smooth and responsive driving experience.
Seat Cover
Breathable material for enhanced comfort. Protects your seats from wear, spills, and daily use.
Infotainment Display
High-resolution touchscreen for seamless control and navigation. Provides real-time information, entertainment, and vehicle settings at your fingertips.
Front LED Light Strip
The front LED light strip provides enhanced visibility with a lightweight, low-power lighting design suited for high-performance racing.
Dihedral Door System
The dihedral door system provides wide, efficient access to the cockpit while combining lightweight construction with McLaren’s distinctive upward-opening design.
Rear Racing Wheel & Tire
The lightweight racing wheel and high-performance tire are designed to maximize grip, responsiveness, and stability under demanding track conditions.
LED Rear Light Assembly
The compact LED rear light assembly provides high visibility while maintaining a lightweight and aerodynamic rear design.
Carbon Fiber Rear Wing
The large carbon-fiber rear wing generates significant downforce to improve rear-end stability and grip at high speeds.
Racing Slick Tire
The racing slick tire maximizes the contact patch with the track, providing high levels of grip, traction, and cornering performance in dry conditions.
Lightweight Racing Wheel
The lightweight racing wheel reduces unsprung mass while maintaining the strength and rigidity required for high-speed competition.
Brake Disc Assembly
The high-performance brake disc assembly provides strong, consistent braking while managing the extreme heat generated during track use.
Pressure Gauge
Displays the current pneumatic system pressure.
High-Pressure Air Lines
Transfers compressed gas through the air-jack system.
